name: Keycloak
description: Keycloak is an open-source identity and access management tool with single sign-on (SSO). Self-host it on your own server with Panara Cloud, which deploys Keycloak as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Identity and access management with SSO. Deploy Keycloak with Docker Compose on Panara Cloud in minutes – free, open source, self-hosted.
